case_store.write_policy: one immutable JSON file per new observed market episode; postmortem audits stored separately and loaded before case history
case_store.reason: append-friendly and conflict-safe while preserving full timestamped evidence and explicit lessons

short_side_policy.principle: Short the failed repair or confirmed bearish leverage expansion, not the liquidation low.
required_checks: price response efficiency versus OI rebuild

youtube_teacher.input_contract: one public youtube.com or youtu.be URL

recommended_runtime_sequence: If the owner supplies a trading YouTube URL, invoke tools/youtube_trader_ingest_auto.py automatically.
Fetch YouTube captions automatically; if absent, attempt configured local ASR; if ASR is unavailable, continue with visual parsing and mark speech missing.
Sample the video into timestamped frames.
Use the local multimodal model to extract factual observations with unreadable values as UNKNOWN/null.
Load the previous compatible Snapshot from the same source/instrument series.
Evaluate BOTH long-reclaim and short-failed-reclaim paths; do not reduce bearish states to only 'no long'.

After capitulation, calculate whether CVD/OI recovery is producing proportional price repair. Large CVD/OI rebuild with weak price response below value is a buyer-efficiency warning and can arm a short candidate on failed reclaim.
Attach future in-video price outcomes when later observations exist.
Store each new live user-supplied market episode as an immutable JSON case under data/trading/cases/YYYY-MM-DD/.
Store postmortem audits under data/trading/audits/ and load them as explicit lessons, not hidden reasoning.
Store raw YouTube teacher episodes as UNVERIFIED and never auto-promote commentary to canonical truth.
Retrieve the verified playbook/rules for explanation and scenario construction.
Do not place an order without a separate explicit execution authorization layer.
